in_sanskrit.name: ग्रहिता
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who seizes, attracts, or holds
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The feminine form of 'Grah', meaning 'to seize, to attract, to hold'. Thus, 'Grahita' means 'One who seizes, attracts, or holds'.

in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of the earth
